pages.title: Refiner's Wisdom
pages.text: The ancient refiners taught: A fine artifact is not born from expensive materials alone, nor is the fiercest flame always the best. True craftsmanship comes from balance, precision, and purity.

pages.title: Choose the Proper Vessel
pages.text: Choose a cauldron with enough slots for every required ingredient.

pages.title: Prepare Sufficient Spirit Stones
pages.text: Keep enough spirit stones available to sustain forging.

pages.title: Examine Material Purity
pages.text: Purity affects both success probability and melting duration.

pages.title: Control the Flame
pages.text: Aim for the target temperature rather than overheating.

pages.title: Complete the Final Quench
pages.text: Remember that molded weapons require water quenching.
